chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 543: The Godking's Ambush – A Realm War Begins
chapter_meta_description: The Godking assembles 68 Empyrean Gods for a surprise attack on the Grand Xia World! Ji Ning and the Xia Emperor are celebrating a victory, unaware of the doom descending. The Realm War begins.
og_description: 68 Empyrean Gods are mobilized. A Realm War is declared. The Grand Xia World is the target. Ji Ning has no idea what's coming.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 543: The Realm War
twitter_description: The Godking springs his trap. Sixty-eight ancient monsters are on the move, targeting Ji Ning.

lore_anchors.definition: A full-scale, total war campaign to conquer an entire region of reality controlled by a major power like a Daofather, not just a single planet or world.
The supreme commander of the Seamless Gate and the sole disciple of the still-slumbering Lord of All Things; he orchestrates the war against the Three Realms.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a True Immortal. A being who has surpassed the mortal plane, commanding immense power and possessing an undying divine body.
A Ki Refiner who has ascended beyond the mortal coil, achieving a Pure Yang Golden Core and effectively infinite lifespan.
A colossal war formation manifested by a legion of Fiendgod soldiers, taking the form of the ancient, headless god Xingtian. This avatar wields world-shattering power.
A legendary technique of Daofather Bodhi that allows him to merge his consciousness with the very fabric of the Three Realms while asleep, granting him omniscient surveillance over vast distances.
The supreme master of the Crimsonbright Realm and one of the most powerful allies of the Nuwa Alliance; his territory is the target of the Seamless Gate's invasion.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Godking have such authority?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is the sole disciple of the supreme being who has not yet awakened, giving him the status of a commander-in-chief over the entire Seamless Gate organization.
It is the Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a True Immortal, a being who has surpassed the mortal plane and attained an undying divine body capable of world-shattering feats.
He uses a technique called ‘Dream of the Three Realms,’ merging his consciousness into reality itself while sleeping, granting him omniscient surveillance.
